title: Lockup: Tampa: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E1 — High Profile
A surprise attack on a sheriff's deputy takes an unexpected turn, a convicted rapist loses his cool in court and an accused murderer in a high profile case tries to cash in on her notoriety.

title: Lockup: New Jersey: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E2 — No Remorse
A threat against an officer leads to a major shakedown; an alleged gang leader becomes a magnet for trouble; a high-speed chase ends with the discovery of a 21-year-old murder victim and now the jail must deal with her cold-blooded killer.

title: Lockup: New Jersey: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E3 — Smoking Gun
A police shootout leaves a paroled inmate in the hospital with 14 bullet wounds and two other men are arrested for their connection to him; a female inmate arrives with what she says is a hair salon mishap, but officers suspect something else.

title: Lockup: New Jersey: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E4 — Going Postal
A new inmate tries to adjust to life in jail, but finds himself with a target on his back and the victim of violence; a drug smuggling scheme is uncovered in the jail's mailroom and a suspect is identified.

title: Lockup: New Jersey: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E5 — Mama's Boy Drug
A dangerous drug makes a comeback in the city of Hackensack, but this time with an "all in the family" twist; inmates are provided with cameras to record their intimate thoughts.

title: Lockup: Tulsa: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E2 — No Escape
An infamous inmate is booked after a daring prison escape, but faces consequences that go well beyond what a judge could give him; Lockup tells the story of a criminal legend, his family and the devastating consequences of his decisions.

title: Lockup: Tulsa: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E3 — Shackled Love
One inmate's troubled past leads to angry outbursts inside the jail, while another arrives after an alleged crime spree that sounds like it's right out of a movie; a young mother could go to prison if she's found guilty of robbery.

title: Lockup: Louisville: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E6 — Bam Bam
One inmate's stress prompts an emergency response; a repeat offender is charged with beating her mother, and now must rely on her own daughter for support; an inmate known for his brawn decides to focus on his brain.

title: Lockup: Holman: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E1 — He Takes No Prisoners
Grant Culliver, warden of one of Alabama's toughest prisons, Holman Correctional Facility, doesn't miss a beat in getting into a disruptive inmate's face, but he's also compassionate and gentle when the situation calls for it.

title: Lockup: San Quentin: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E3 — The Conjugal Visit
San Quentin's warden says that other than an inmate's release date, visits are the most important things in their lives; for some, visits are rare moments of intimacy; for others, they are business transaction opportunities.
